advisories.reason: ReDoS in picomatch's extglob handling, high, affecting every version through 4.0.7 with no patched release yet. It is installed only for dev tooling (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir and lint-staged), which match it against patterns from this repository's own config and file paths, never input from users, and nothing under src/ imports it. package-lock marks it dev, which means npm reached it only from devDependencies, not that no output of those tools ships: the build does ship, but the build does not run picomatch on anything a user sends. npm audit --omit=dev finds nothing in the root or functions trees. When a fixed picomatch is published, take it (an overrides entry if a tool pins the old range) and delete this entry.
